tool_notes.inspect_screens: Call it once, without arguments. It returns the screen pictures, measured_problems per cut (the program's measured problems with their what id, where, now and change_to), designer_may_change per cut (layouts that hold the cut's material count, unused candidates of the cut, her text slots) and, from the second check on, last_review. List every measured problem in its cut with the same what id and copy its now; you add only B4 (by eye) and P2 notes.
tool_notes.save_output: Save once, after every content cut has an entry. If it is refused, change only the entries the message names.

cut.description: a content cut id (not the title or end cut); every content cut once

verdict.description: P1 good; P2 a little off but fine to watch (write note); problems: list them

note.description: only for P2: what is a little off, one sentence; empty otherwise

what.description: the checklist id: B1-B5 minor (the Slide Builder fixes it by placement), D1-D6 severe (the Screen Designer changes the layout, a material or her text)

where.description: the slot id or element (copy where from a measured problem); for new text, the designer's text slot id

now.description: what the screen shows now: copy the measured value; for B4 describe it in words, no numbers

change_to.description: concrete, different from now. B: one placement change (size, weight tier, line breaks, alignment or position in the slot, spacing, scaling or cropping, appearance timing). D: exactly a bare layout id or unused candidate id from designer_may_change, 'drop <candidate id>', 'another layout', or (D2 and D5 only) new text for her text slot named in where; or a copy of the measured change_to

why.description: one sentence: what you see on the screen

notes.description: things neither worker can change (narration, directions, a material's own quality, missing candidates, the layout library); kept in the run record, never sent back
